content: pydub (MIT, first released 2011) requires ffmpeg/libav as an external binary for MP3; not a good fit for a no-external-binary-install goal. lameenc (LGPLv3, chrisstaite/lameenc) is a pure Python-C-extension binding to libmp3lame with prebuilt wheels for win_amd64/cp311+ on PyPI -- no separate ffmpeg/libmp3lame install needed on Windows. This is the correct WAV-to-MP3 path for Piper output.
